full_judgment:
Md Rezaul Haque, J: On an application under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure, Rule was issued calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the Judgment and order dated 20-1-2016 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, 1st Court, Chittagong, in Criminal Revision No. 144 of 2010, allowing the revision and thereby setting aside the order dared 14-3-2010 passed by the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Chittagong in Banshkhali police station Case No. 36 dated 20-12-2007, corresponding to GR No. 447 of 2007 under sections 143/448/323/324/326 and 307 should not be quashed and/or pass such other or further order or orders as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 6. Thereafter challenging the said order of discharge from some section the informant (opposite party No. 2) being petitioner filed a Criminal Revision before the Sessions Judge being Criminal Revision No. 144 of 2010 and after hearing the said Criminal Revision the learned Additional Sessions Judge allowed the Revision by setting aside the order of the learned Magistrate vide judgment and order dated 13-3-2010.
